reason:
Added replacement for HAL_UARTEx_ReceiveToIdle_IT to fix exceptional loop issue. This function contains MMIO operations (ATOMIC_SET_BIT) and calls UART_Start_Receive_IT. The replacement:
1. Skips the call to UART_Start_Receive_IT which may have hardware dependencies
2. Sets up the receive state directly
3. Skips hardware-specific operations (__HAL_UART_CLEAR_IDLEFLAG and ATOMIC_SET_BIT)
4. Uses HAL_BE_In to read data from stdin in emulation
5. IMPORTANT: Never calls HAL_UARTEx_RxEventCallback to avoid loops (calls standard receive callback instead)
6. Properly manages the UART state machine
This should prevent the exceptional loop issue while maintaining functionality.
